meta.title: 8-Day Morocco Desert & Atlantic Coast Tour | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: An 8-day shared group tour from Marrakech combining the Sahara desert, Marrakech city time, and the Atlantic port of Essaouira. From €579pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared, fixed-date group tour combining the Sahara desert, Marrakech, and the Atlantic coast at Essaouira. From €579pp.

hero.lead: Marrakech → Sahara Desert Camp → Marrakech → Essaouira → Marrakech

overview.h2: Dunes, medina, and sea air in one trip
paras: This route balances our two most-requested Marrakech experiences — the Sahara desert camp and the laid-back Atlantic port of Essaouira — with two free days in Marrakech itself to recover, shop, and explore at your own pace.
Total driving distance is around 1,345 km, spread over eight days with two full rest days built in.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Marrakech to Dades Valley via Ait Benhaddou
paras: Cross the High Atlas via the Tizi n'Tichka pass, stopping at the UNESCO-listed Ait Benhaddou kasbah, continuing to the Dades Valley for the night.

days.label: Desert
days.title: Dades Valley to Merzouga Sahara camp
paras: Morning at the Dades Gorge, then across the Todra Gorge (≈55 km/1 hr) to Merzouga (≈180 km/3.5 hrs). Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes for a night at the shared desert camp.

days.label: Return
days.title: Sahara camp to Ouarzazate
paras: Optional sunrise over the dunes, then a scenic drive back across the Atlas via Tinghir and Todra, arriving in Ouarzazate for the night.

days.label: Marrakech
days.title: Ouarzazate back to Marrakech
paras: Final crossing of the High Atlas, arriving back in Marrakech by mid-afternoon with the evening free in the medina. Overnight in Marrakech.

days.label: Free Day
days.title: Free day in Marrakech
paras: A full rest day in Marrakech — join an optional add-on (hammam, cooking class, or Atlas Mountains half-day) or simply explore the souks and gardens at your own pace. Overnight in Marrakech.

days.label: Coast
days.title: Marrakech to Essaouira
paras: Drive west through argan forests to the Atlantic coast. Guided walk through Essaouira's UNESCO-listed medina and sea ramparts on arrival. Overnight in Essaouira.

days.label: Coast
days.title: Essaouira free day
paras: Free day to explore the fishing port, art galleries, and beach, with grilled seafood lunch at the port a local highlight. Optional surfing or horseback riding add-ons available. Overnight in Essaouira.

days.label: Depart
days.title: Essaouira back to Marrakech
paras: Return drive to Marrakech for onward travel. Trip ends.

intro: Seven nights, shared throughout. Expect the same style and price bracket as these real budget properties in each location.

cards.title: Night 1 · Dades Gorges
html: Luxury Dades Riad or Auberge Tissadrin, half board (HB) — a kasbah-style riad with mudbrick rooms and terrace gorge views, dinner included.

cards.title: Night 2 · Merzouga desert camp
html: Ideal Desert Camp, half board (HB) — dorm tents at the dunes' edge, shared bathrooms, dinner and breakfast included.

cards.title: Night 3 · Ouarzazate
html: A budget guesthouse near the medina, similar to Le Petit Riad — simple twin rooms, rooftop terrace.

cards.title: Nights 4–5 · Marrakech
html: A medina riad in the same bracket as Riad Jennah Rouge or Riad les Oliviers — dorm beds from around €15, walking distance to Jemaa el-Fnaa.

cards.title: Nights 6–7 · Essaouira
html: A coastal medina guesthouse comparable to Riad Aylal — simple rooms a short walk from the port and ramparts.

cards.title: Private upgrade
html: Private rooms are available on every night as a paid upgrade — let us know at booking, subject to availability.

includes: Shared transport in an air-conditioned minivan
Camel trek and 1 night at the desert camp
Guided walking tours in Marrakech and Essaouira
excludes: Optional add-ons (hammam, cooking class, surfing, horseback riding)
Private rooms (available on request, extra cost)

good.h2: Two rest days built into the route
paras: Groups are capped at 16 travelers. Departures run every Saturday year-round — book early for October–April, our busiest season.
The two free days in Marrakech and Essaouira are intentionally unstructured — a good chance to book a spa, cooking class, or surf lesson on top of the base trip.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure, final price, and payment instructions by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Are the free days really free, or guided?
items.a: Fully free — no scheduled activities. We're happy to recommend or help book optional add-ons like a hammam, cooking class, or surf lesson.

items.q: Do I need to rejoin the same group after the free days?
items.a: Yes — the group and vehicle stay together for the whole route, including the Marrakech-to-Essaouira legs.

items.q: Is accommodation shared for all 7 nights?
items.a: Yes, the €579 price is based on shared twin/dorm rooms throughout. A private room upgrade is available on request, subject to availability.

items.q: What should I pack for the desert night?
items.a: Desert nights get cold even in summer — bring a warm layer, plus sunscreen, a scarf or hat for wind and sun, and comfortable walking shoes.

items.q: What if the group doesn't fill up?
items.a: Departures run on fixed weekly dates regardless of group size — your trip runs even if only a few seats are booked.
